title: Behavioral-fingerprint watchlist for cost-tuner safe apply/rollback
creator: Ethan Clarke
description: Build a behavioral-fingerprint based watchlist and evaluation runner that attaches to the cost-tuner (batching/caching recommender) so each proposed config change is scored for quality risk before automated apply and can be rapidly rolled back if regressions are detected. This ticket covers: a lightweight fingerprint extraction for request+response pairs, a curated watchlist of high-risk customer prompt families, a statistical delta-risk scoring model, integration points for micro-canary rollout, and orchestration of safe apply/rollback flows with human-in-the-loop escalation. Aim is to reduce silent quality regressions from cost-driven config changes while preserving >60% of projected cost savings from autotune recommendations.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Fingerprint extractor implemented and produces stable vector signatures for text responses (deterministic across runtime restarts). 2) Watchlist store seeded with 250 prompt families derived from production telemetry + customer-reported cases. 3) Delta-risk scorer emits an interpretable score (0-100) and a categorical label (ok/warn/block) using both semantic-similarity and behavioral metrics (length drift, hallucination markers, entity-drop). 4) When risk >= block, the cost-tuner must not auto-apply; risk in warn triggers micro-canary (1% traffic) with extended monitoring. 5) Rollback path works end-to-end within 5 minutes with provenance tags and audit log entry. 6) Integration tests and smoke harness added and green in CI. 7) Documentation (Confluence) and runbook for on-call included.
tasks: Spike: evaluate candidate fingerprint representations (minhash n-gram, sentence-transformer, token-level fingerprints) - 2d
Design watchlist schema and provenance tagging (prompt family id, owner, whitelisted-patterns) - 1d
Implement extractor as middleware in runtime request path (opt-in) - 3d
Build delta-risk scorer service with configurable thresholds and explainability fields - 3d
Seed watchlist from top telemetry clusters and internal incident corpus - 2d
Integrate with cost-tuner reviewer: block/warn/ok policy enforcement and micro-canary launcher - 2d
Add rollback orchestration and audit log entries (KVS + console event) - 2d
Create CI smoke tests and synthetic golden-suite harness - 2d
Author Confluence doc, runbook, and dashboard templates - 1d
notes: This approach favors behavioral signals over purely lexical diffs so we can catch subtle quality regressions introduced by batching/caching (e.g., missing context across concatenated requests, KV-cache leakage). The watchlist will be opt-in for private deployments initially and enforced for hosted customers in high-sensitivity tiers.
risk_and_tradeoffs:
- Strong fingerprinting increases CPU during inference path; mitigate via sampling and async scoring.
- Too-strict thresholds will block beneficial cost saves; will calibrate with historical replay and a staged canary.
- False positives possible on benign paraphrase drift; add human review queue and feedback loop.
rollout_plan: 1) Internal-only: run scoring in shadow for 2 weeks on 10% sampled traffic. 2) Replay historical autotune changes against watchlist to estimate false-positive rate. 3) Enable warn-mode enforcement for non-production customers. 4) Enable block-mode for P0 customers with manual-approval fallback. 5) Full auto-apply only after 4 weeks of low FP and stakeholder signoff.
monitoring: Delta-risk time series, FP/TP counts, rollback frequency, cost-saved delta vs quality-regression incidents. Create dashboard panels for: risk-prioritized recent changes, micro-canary success rate, and per-customer watchlist hits.
